entry.title: Reducing Software Testing Costs: Pareto Principle + Murphy’s Law in QA
entry.summary: Software testing costs spike when teams spread effort too thin across low-impact checks. In reality, most defects come from a small set of cases — and uncaught regressions appear exactly where you least expect them. In 2025, smart QA teams use two rules to cut costs and boost quality Pareto Principle: Focus the critical 20% of tests that catch the majority of defects. Murphy’s Law: Automate regression tests to find the failures that will inevitably surface.
